annotations.title: What lenders say a company's loan is worth

description: Private credit marks for a US company: every BDC (business development company) fund that holds its first-lien term loan, the fair value each reported as a share of par in its 10-Q for 2026-06-30 (SEC filings), the manager (Ares, Blue Owl, Goldman, Golub, Apollo...) and how far the lenders disagree. A low mark by one manager tends to lead: lenders 10-20 points above the lowest peer cut by 5+ points the next quarter 20.4% of the time vs 2.8% when lenders agree. Free: lowest and highest manager mark, the gap and three funds. full=true: every fund's mark, par, prior-quarter mark and filing link with a Tensorust key.

full.description: true returns every linked object and property. Needs a Tensorust key (Authorization: Bearer tdk_...). Omit for the free preview.
